items.title: Coca-Cola Stock (KO) May Struggle to Repeat Its Strong 2026 Performance
items.summary: Coca-Cola (KO) stock may struggle to repeat its strong 2026 performance, as reported revenue growth could slow next year and its valuation leaves limited room for further gains. Shares of the beverage maker have soared in 2026, with investors cheering accelerating revenue and earnings growth after a weak 2025. items.title: Positive Trial Results Could Be A Big Moment For Eli Lilly Stock
items.summary: Eli Lilly used ObesityWeek 2026 to share late-stage data on EloraTZP, retatrutide and Foundayo, showing strong effects on weight, A1C, sleep apnea severity and knee osteoarthritis pain in adults with obesity and related conditions. The breadth of positive findings across multiple organs and diseases suggests Eli Lilly is positioning its incretin portfolio as a cardiometabolic platform rather than a single-product obesity story.
